title.en: Count the Readings for Each Day

brief.zh: 为记录员准备一张表，显示每一天有多少条有效数据。
brief.en: Make a table that tells the record keeper how many valid readings each day has.

concept.zh: 先按日期分组，再分别统计每组的条数。
concept.en: Group the readings by day, then count each group separately.

hints.zh: 几个日期就有几条汇总行。检查第 2 天为什么只剩两条。
hints.en: Expect one summary row per day. Check why day 2 has only two valid readings.

prompt.zh: 输出第 1 至 4 天各自的有效记录数。
prompt.en: Return a valid reading count for each of days 1 through 4.
